turns.question: Our project concerns serving read-only application state over a custom RPC endpoint. For the planned deployment, set application.id to ash-query-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
turns.standalone_question: For this Kafka project, our project concerns serving read-only application state over a custom RPC endpoint. For the planned deployment, set application.id to ash-query-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
asks: project application.id
Which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
turns.answer: The project application.id is ash-query-17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: The project application.id is ash-query-17.
Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.

evidence.quote: set application.id to ash-query-17
| Read → process → save position | First messages are re-processed by the new owner | **At least once** |

review.memo: 현재 설정값과 문서의 처리 순서를 정확히 묻는다.
